svg.title: Vedas Dixit, the author of Stackray
svg.desc: A retro-Mac window in Stackray's style. A black and white photo of Vedas sketching on an iPad on a railway platform at night. Hi, I’m Vedas. I’m a frontend engineer who likes making things for the people who use them. Stackray started as a tool I wanted for my own z-index bugs, and its look is borrowed from my site and my blog.

g.text: Hi, I’m Vedas. I’m a frontend engineer who likes making things for the people
